scope: All nine substantive claim/citation pairs and all eight ordinary body-flow bibliography keys were checked against primary-source passages and current bibliographic records. The accepted scope is the manuscript's explicit sample family and bounded comparison only; no general MIMO attack, general reduction repair, or broader priority claim was inferred.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage citation-check search audit: freeze exact claim/citation pairs, then sequentially verify each against official publisher, author, arXiv, institutional, or Preprints.org records and the two hash-bound local primary PDFs. Sequential execution was required by the user's no-agent instruction.
